# Register entries of the compliance engine (NEXOPS ONE)

Customers who use the compliance engine (NEXOPS ONE) record its supplier in their DORA register of information
(template B_05.01, ICT third-party service providers). This folder gives that entry as a canonical
batch, so it can be imported as it is instead of being retyped:

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `nexops-one-register.json` | a full-mode canonical batch with one `ict_provider` record |
| `manifest.json` | the manifest of its adapter, `vendor-dd-pack` |
| `vendor-facts.json` | the facts it is generated from |

## Import

```bash
compliance-engine validate nexops-one-register.json
curl -X PUT "$URL/api/v1/adapters/vendor-dd-pack/manifest" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --data-binary @manifest.json
curl -X POST "$URL/api/v1/ingestions" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --data-binary @nexops-one-register.json
```

The batch is full-mode for its own adapter: importing a newer version replaces this record and touches
nothing else in the register. The customer then adds what only it knows, referring to the provider code
of the record: the contractual arrangement (B_02.01), the service lines with the functions supported
(B_02.02, B_06.01) and its own assessment of the service (B_07.01).

The product is software the customer runs itself (self-hosted, or embedded in NEXOPS ONE in the
customer's environment): it stores and processes no customer data on the vendor's side, so there are no
data locations, subcontractors (B_05.02) or service lines to declare from the vendor's side for these
modes. A hosted offering, when it exists, will add them (see [../subprocessors.md](../subprocessors.md)).

## Pending facts

These facts are not established yet. They are left out of the batch, so the customer's completeness
view shows them as missing; they are never filled with guesses. Complete `vendor-facts.json` and
regenerate before publishing the pack.

| Fact | Note |
|---|---|
| `lei` | LEI of the legal entity that contracts with customers, if it has one; until then the provider code is vendor:nexops-one |
| `legal_name` | registered name of that legal entity |
| `name_latin` | the name in Latin characters, only when the registered name is not |
| `person_type` | type of person (EBA codelist value), to be taken from the official codelist |
| `hq_country` | country of the registered office (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) |
| `currency` | currency of the contracts (ISO 4217) |
| `parent_id_code` | ultimate parent undertaking, if any (leave null and mark not applicable when there is none) |
| `parent_id_type` | type of the parent's code (EBA codelist value) |
